name: IKEA PS 2026 Chair bed, Skiftebo light grey-beige

dimensions.source: IKEA Measurements tab, read in Chrome 2026-10-23. w is the Width row and h the Height row. The rows have no overall Depth, so d is the closed depth printed on the same tab's dimension drawing ('Illustration with measurements for the product: IKEA PS 2026', 84 cm (33 1/8")), opened at full size (1400 px) in Chrome; the drawing also gives the opened bed: 203 cm (79 7/8") long overall (the Bed length row), the mattress 201 cm (79 1/8") by 80 cm (31 1/2"), 19 cm (7 1/2") thick

notes: Flags: fits. Fit: F-62's small daybed for the office. Closed it is 31 1/2" wide by 33 1/8" deep (1,043 sq in), a third of the HEMNES daybed it replaces (ikea-30349329: 78 3/8 x 41 3/8", 3,243 sq in, and 76 3/4" deep pulled out), and it still sleeps one adult on a 79 1/8 x 31 1/2" mattress, 7 1/2" thick. Opened, it runs 79 7/8" forward from its back: from the side wall of the 106" room that leaves 26" for the desk opposite, so in a and d its last 5 3/8" slides under the MITTZON desk opposite, raised for the night (24 3/8-49 5/8" high); that desk's legs stand near its ends with T-feet running front to back, so the bed's foot goes between them (in a, angled a few degrees toward the window to clear the door-end leg). A getting-in side of 24" or more runs along it (F-34). Seat height 16 1/8", seat depth 25 5/8", back 29 1/2" high. Skiftebo light grey-beige cover with blue accent buttons. F-22: closed 31 1/2 x 33 1/8 x 29 1/2", under 30" in its smallest dimension, so it passes a 30" door even assembled; the page offers assembly service ($6.50*). New; 4.2 stars (37). Other cover: Skiftebo bright orange (ikea-80620379, not opened). Designer Matilda Lindstam Nilsson; 10 year limited warranty. Article 106.203.73. Stock 2026-10-23: in stock at IKEA Long Island, NY; click and collect free; home delivery to our ZIP from $39.00. rooms: back-bedroom, from the redesign brief (F-62).
